newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher as investors return.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher as investors return.

text.p: Dhaka stocks bounced back to close up by more than four percent as investors began to return, ending a lingering bear run, brokers said.
Brokers said the share prices were attractive after many of them fell to a record low over the past seven days.
Broker Khurshid Alam said: "The small investors were eager to buy shares as most of the scrips reached to the ground level. The prices have become very attractive."
"I had a number of buying orders. Many were waiting for this opportunity," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.

But there are other views too. Some brokers felt Tuesday's rise had no reason other than an effort by some market players to restore confidence of the traders in the kerb market. The retail investors have been agitating outside the bourse against persistent decline in share prices and urged the authorities to halt the slide immediately.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index gained 36.14 points or 4.01 percent at 935.52 on a turnover of 38.1 million taka. Gainers led losers by 102 to 16. Leasing company IDLC rose 30.63, food stock Pran gained 17.27 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 8.84 to 102.76.
